ticker: WELCOME TO THE 2025 B.B.G.C. — Twenty-four teams, four groups, one trophy. And a defending champion with something to prove.

GROUP PLAY · PINK — White Zin picked up exactly where they left off: 5-0, 97 points, nobody laid a glove on them. Then a straight dead heat for second — Brothers Boor and Holy Rollers both 3-2, 74 points to 75 — and it went to the head-to-head. CooCoo 4 Coconuts finished 0-5. WHITE ZIN, BROTHERS BOOR and HOLY ROLLERS advance.

GROUP PLAY · GREEN — Muck Fichigan went through unbeaten at 4-0-1, the only team in the tournament nobody could beat. The Seekers took second at 3-2 and Mag Dick third at 2-2-1 — file that name away. MUCK FICHIGAN, THE SEEKERS and MAG DICK advance.

GROUP PLAY · YELLOW — Glory Holz took it at 4-1 with 87 points. Guns n Rollers and the Hawkeyes both came home 3-2, split by a single point, 78 to 71. D-Boccery propped up the group at 1-4. GLORY HOLZ, GUNS N ROLLERS and HAWKEYES advance.

GROUP PLAY · BLUE — As tight as it gets at the top: Joanie Loves Bocce AND Smug Champs both 4-1, with Smug Champs scoring more, 88 to 83 — and Joanie taking the group anyway. Sparty Devils third at 2-3. JOANIE LOVES BOCCE, SMUG CHAMPS and SPARTY DEVILS advance.

ROUND ONE — Holy Rollers ended Guns n Rollers in an all-Rollers affair. Smug Champs put out Sparty Devils. Brothers Boor knocked out the Hawkeyes. And MAG DICK — third in their own group — took down the The Seekers. The upsets had started early.

QUARTERFINALS — White Zin brushed past Holy Rollers. Muck Fichigan ended Brothers Boor. Smug Champs knocked out group champions Joanie Loves Bocce. And Mag Dick went and did it AGAIN, putting out Glory Holz, a group winner, to reach the final four from the eleven line.
SEMIFINALS — White Zin ended the Smug Champs' run, and Muck Fichigan finally stopped Mag Dick. The defending champions against the only team nobody had beaten all tournament.

THE FINAL — Muck Fichigan: 4-0-1 in Green, unbeaten across the entire tournament, two bracket wins on the way. White Zin: 5-0 in Pink, 97 points, the defending champions, and a chance to do something nobody in the archive had ever done.

🏆 CHAMPIONS: WHITE ZIN — BACK-TO-BACK 🏆 — Perfect in the group, perfect in the bracket, and in the final they took down the last unbeaten team in the field. Two titles in two years, the first repeat champions in B.B.G.C. history — and from the club that lost the 2018 final and waited six years for the first one. A dynasty, written in red.
